card.name: Digits inside numbers in trial results
card.fires_on: A single digit token within a number, usually right after a decimal point or as the second digit, in clinical-trial percentages, doses and lab values.

modes.label: Decimal digit in percentages
modes.description: A digit after a decimal point in an incidence percentage.

modes.label: Digit in doses or changes
modes.description: A digit inside a dose or a change-from-baseline figure.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of numbers in trial result tables, like the 1 in 9.1%.
